bram.title: The Sworn Blade
bram.blurb: An oath-sworn swordsman with a scar for every promise he kept. He can hold a road on his own, and he does not have to: the archer and the priest came with him.

sera.title: The Longbow
sera.blurb: A ranger who would rather end a fight from the treeline. Nothing about her survives being caught in the open, and there is only Toln behind her to put it right.

toln.title: The Hedge Priest
toln.blurb: A village healer walking well past the last village. He mends what Bram breaks, and if Bram goes down there is nobody left who can swing anything.

fox_knight.title: The Fox Fire Knight
fox_knight.blurb: Fast, burning, and travelling alone by choice. Strong enough to win most fights outright, with nobody to pick him up out of the one he loses.

village_idiot.title: The Village Idiot
village_idiot.blurb: No oath, no training, no company, and no idea what any of this is for. Everything the valley throws at you, you take on the chin — alone.
